# FAQ-001 Engineering FAQ #1

Revision: Rev A

Q: What torque is required for the main ram bolt on Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02)?
A: Use the specified main ram bolt torque for EQ-P1-L3-HP02: 1330 N·m. Reference tightening procedure in SOP-P2-L2-04 and design change ECN-2026-034.

Q: How often must the main roll bearings be lubricated on Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01)?
A: Adhere to the lubrication interval for EQ-P1-L1-RR01: 120 hours. Lubrication task detail and lubricant type are in SB-1017 and SOP-P2-L2-04.

Q: What is the system pressure limit for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01)?
A: The system pressure limit for EQ-P3-L1-HP01 shall not exceed 330 bar. See ECN-2026-034 for pressure setpoint updates and SOP-P2-L2-04 for verification steps.

Q: What torque is required for the mandrel clamp bolts on Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)?
A: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for EQ-P2-L2-RR03 is 620 N·m. Verify bolt condition and follow SOP-P2-L2-04 for sequence and verification; record any deviations per ECN-2026-034.

Q: What is the maximum allowable ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)?
A: The maximum ring outer diameter for EQ-P2-L2-RR03 is 1525 mm. Ensure tooling and guard clearance per SB-1017 and update job setup per SOP-P2-L2-04.

Related documents: ECN-2026-034, SB-1017, SOP-P2-L2-04
